answer: Sybil tax at the harbor gate: every new identity pays a sunk 10 POA entry tax before it can work, never refunded. Each epoch a warden spot-checks 5% of identities; one caught running multiple shells loses its seat and its tax. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 10 = 10,000 POA sunk, while one honest agent pays 10 POA once and keeps its full reward, its opal badge rising toward the zenith of reputation instead of being diluted by fakes.
